description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific invitee of a scheduled event, using their unique UUIDs.

event_uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the scheduled event.
event_uuid.title: Event Uuid

invitee_uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the invitee for the specified event.
invitee_uuid.title: Invitee Uuid

name: get_event_invitee

canceled_by.description: The name of the person who canceled the event.
canceled_by.title: Canceled By

created_at.description: Timestamp when the cancellation occurred in ISO 8601 format.
created_at.title: Created At

reason.description: The reason provided for the cancellation.
reason.title: Reason

resource.description: The invitee resource object containing full details of the invitee.
resource.title: Resource

Invitee.description: Represents an invitee for a scheduled Calendly event.

cancel_url.description: URL for the invitee to cancel the scheduled event.
cancel_url.title: Cancel Url

cancellation.description: Cancellation details for the event. Present only if the event has been canceled.
cancellation.title: Cancellation

created_at.description: Timestamp when the invitee was created in ISO 8601 format.
created_at.title: Created At

event.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the associated scheduled event.
event.title: Event

first_name.description: The invitee's first name. This field is present when the invitee's name is collected in separate fields.
first_name.title: First Name

last_name.description: The invitee's last name. This field is present when the invitee's name is collected in separate fields.
last_name.title: Last Name

new_invitee.description: Reference URI to the new invitee record if this invitee rescheduled. Null if the event was not rescheduled.
new_invitee.title: New Invitee

no_show.description: No-show information for the invitee. Present only if the invitee has been marked as a no-show.
no_show.title: No Show

old_invitee.description: Reference URI to the previous invitee record if this invitee rescheduled. Null if the event was not rescheduled.
old_invitee.title: Old Invitee

payment.description: Payment information for the scheduled event. Null if no payment is associated with the booking.
payment.title: Payment

questions_and_answers.description: List of custom questions and the invitee's answers from the booking form.
questions_and_answers.title: Questions And Answers

reconfirmation.description: Reconfirmation data for the invitee. Present only when reconfirmation is enabled for the event type and reconfirmation has been requested.
reconfirmation.title: Reconfirmation

reschedule_url.description: URL for the invitee to reschedule the scheduled event.
reschedule_url.title: Reschedule Url

rescheduled.description: Indicates whether the event has been rescheduled.
rescheduled.title: Rescheduled

status.description: Indicates the invitee's status, typically 'active' or 'canceled'.
status.title: Status

text_reminder_number.description: The phone number in E.164 format for SMS reminders. Null if no phone number was provided.
text_reminder_number.title: Text Reminder Number

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the invitee was last updated in ISO 8601 format.
updated_at.title: Updated At

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the invitee.
uri.title: Uri

Invitee.title: Invitee

created_at.description: Timestamp when the no-show was created in ISO 8601 format.
created_at.title: Created At

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the no-show resource.
uri.title: Uri

PaymentInfo.description: Payment information for the scheduled event.
PaymentInfo.title: PaymentInfo

QuestionAnswer.description: Represents a question and answer pair from the booking form.

answer.description: The invitee's answer to the question. For checkbox questions, multiple answers are separated by newline characters.
answer.title: Answer

position.description: The position (order) of the question in the booking form, starting from 0.
position.title: Position

question.description: The text of the question asked to the invitee.
question.title: Question

QuestionAnswer.title: QuestionAnswer

confirmed_at.description: Timestamp when invitee confirmed attendance in ISO 8601 format. Null until invitee takes action.
confirmed_at.title: Confirmed At

created_at.description: Timestamp when reconfirmation notification was sent in ISO 8601 format.
created_at.title: Created At

TrackingInfo.description: Tracking information for marketing attribution and integrations.

salesforce_uuid.description: Salesforce UUID for CRM integration. Null if not provided.
salesforce_uuid.title: Salesforce Uuid

utm_campaign.description: UTM campaign parameter passed via the scheduling URL. Null if not provided.
utm_campaign.title: Utm Campaign

utm_content.description: UTM content parameter passed via the scheduling URL. Null if not provided.
utm_content.title: Utm Content

utm_medium.description: UTM medium parameter passed via the scheduling URL. Null if not provided.
utm_medium.title: Utm Medium

utm_source.description: UTM source parameter passed via the scheduling URL. Null if not provided.
utm_source.title: Utm Source

utm_term.description: UTM term parameter passed via the scheduling URL. Null if not provided.
utm_term.title: Utm Term

TrackingInfo.title: TrackingInfo
